title: Google's NEW Gemini AI Agent Explained — 3 Workflows & the Catch
description:
Google's October 8, 2026 Gemini agent announcement shows where workplace AI is heading. In this video we explain dedicated AI coworkers and three clearly labeled illustrative workflows: email triage, spreadsheet verification, and report drafting. We also show the real catch: permissions, enterprise access, human approvals, and auditability.

Google's official announcement: https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/welcome-to-gemini-at-work-2026

captions.text: An AI coworker that prepares real work — then asks to send?
What Google actually announced on October 8.
Demo workflow 1: check the order, draft a reply, approve the send.
Demo workflow 2: spot the 12 versus 13 order mismatch.
Demo workflow 3: turn approved notes into a review-ready report.
What permissions and rollout actually mean.
Green: read. Yellow: draft. Red: seek explicit approval.
AI at work should expand ability, not remove accountability.
